Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Makardhwaj Upadhyay, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Parmeshwar Mehta, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 2 15-02-2023 Heard the parties.

This is an application for quashing of the order dated 17.10.2014 passed in Ara Town P.S. Case No.
256 of 2014; G.R. No. 3144 of 2014 passed by the learned S.D.J.M., Bhojpur, Ara under Sections 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submit that the present petitioners are brother-in-laws (Bhaisur), sister-in-laws (Gotni) and the nephew of the informant.

They have absolutely Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.24946 of 2015(2) dt.15-02-2023 nothing to do with the present case and have orally partitioned, nothing to do with the said incident but have been illegally dragged in this case.
